user.title: Elmer
user.description: Adds Elmer to your sidebar. Nothing to configure — everything else is set inside the panel.

complete.name: Mark a routine done
complete.description: Records a routine as completed, draws down any parts it consumes, and adds a history entry.

undo.name: Undo a completion
undo.description: Reverses the most recent completion and puts back the parts it took.

adjust_stock.name: Adjust part stock
adjust_stock.description: Adds to or takes from the quantity on hand.
